prompt: The first-person perspective begins with a slow, steady movement forward along a snowy trail in the Mardi Himal region of Kaski, Nepal, under the cover of night. The camera glides smoothly over the uneven terrain, capturing the fine texture of the snow-covered ground interspersed with patches of exposed earth and scattered rocks. As the viewer progresses, the surrounding trees loom large, their dark silhouettes stark against the dimly lit sky, creating an immersive sense of depth and enclosure. The camera angle remains low, focusing primarily on the path ahead, but occasionally pans slightly to reveal more of the dense forest on either side. The ambient light is minimal, casting long shadows and giving the scene a bluish hue, while faint specks of light, possibly distant stars or reflections, twinkle faintly above. The environment is entirely devoid of human presence, emphasizing the solitude and quietude of the nocturnal wilderness. The continuous forward motion of the camera maintains a consistent pace, enhancing the feeling of a solitary journey through this serene, snow-laden landscape.
